subject: Invoice routing and PO field mapping for new vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@acme-supplies.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission (portal vs email)

Hi Monica / Jordan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. We are finalizing our billing flow and need one detail clarified before we start sending invoices to Redwood: do you prefer vendors to upload invoices to your partner portal (Payflow) or email invoices to invoices@redwood.com as a fallback?

A couple of specifics we hit on while preparing our billing files:
- We have Redwood PO numbers printed at the top of the invoice PDF, but our ERP also exports the PO as a separate CSV field (line-level and header-level). Do you need the PO stamped in a specific PDF location, or is a CSV/field that maps to PO_number sufficient for your AP parser?
- Preferred file types for ingestion (we can produce PDF + matching CSV, or a single XML/UBL file if that’s easier)
- If portal is required, can you share SFTP/portal credentials or an activation link? We saw a Payflow merchant activation page but were unsure if Redwood does onboarding or Payflow handles it.

Attached: sample invoice PDF and a tiny CSV extract from our ERP (first two lines).

We can follow whichever path minimizes exceptions — happy to walk through a one-off ingestion test.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Accounts Receivable
Acme Supplies Inc.
[Attachment: ACME_INV_20270520.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: acme_invoice_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission (portal vs email)

Hi Elena — thanks for the sample files and the clear questions. Short answers up front, then a few implementation details so your team can pick the least error-prone path.

TL;DR: Prefer portal (Payflow) for recurring vendors — it gives better parsing and tracking. Email is an allowed fallback for the first 30 days after activation for smaller batches. We need BOTH a header-level PO field and a matching PO value on the invoice PDF (as a visible line near invoice header) to reduce exceptions.

Requirements and recommendations:
- Primary path: portal upload to Payflow. Please use the activation link below to create your merchant account; once you’re live the ingestion will map CSV header PO_number -> our PO field automatically.
- Fallback path: invoices@redwood.com; subject line must include: PO:{PO_NUMBER} | VENDOR:ACME to route correctly. Example subject: "PO:12345 | VENDOR:ACME"
- File formats we accept: PDF (invoice visual) + accompanying CSV (recommended) OR single UBL/XML. If you send only PDF, include a one-line CSV (invoice_id, po_number, gross_amount, invoice_date) to help the parser.
- PO placement in PDF: visible near the top-right header. If your ERP cannot stamp the PDF, ensure the CSV contains the exact PO_number and include that same PO_number in the email subject.
- Line-item SKU mapping: optional for now. If you provide SKU codes in CSV column sku_code, we will attach them to the invoice lines in AP — helpful for PO reconciliation but not required to start.
- Attachment naming: please use the pattern ACME_INV_{YYYYMMDD}.pdf and ACME_LINES_{YYYYMMDD}.csv — consistent filenames reduce manual exceptions.

I pasted a minimal CSV template below you can copy/paste into your export:

invoice_id,po_number,gross_amount,invoice_date,sku_code,line_qty,line_unit_price
INV-20270520,PO-98765,523.40,2027-05-20,SKU-11,2,120.00

Next steps:
1) Please try the merchant activation here and confirm once you see the "Upload invoices" option: https://payflow.io/merchant/activation/ACME-5932
2) If you prefer we can run a one-off test ingestion — upload a zipped PDF+CSV set and Jordan will watch exceptions in the console.

Cc'ing Vivek for any exception policy questions (e.g., temporary email fallback windows, PO stamping exceptions).

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Monica cell: +1 415-555-0147]
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.docx (docx)]

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission (portal vs email)

Thanks, Monica — that is very clear and exactly what we needed. A few follow-ups:

- We can produce PDF + one-line CSV export. I attached a CSV exported from our ERP with the two test invoices (we obfuscated customer data).
- For the subject line fallback, is the exact literal string required ("PO:12345 | VENDOR:ACME") or will you accept variations (e.g., "PO#12345")? We can make the subject consistent but want to avoid fragile parsing.
- Activation link worked; Payflow asked for a Redwood merchant ID. If Redwood issues the merchant mapping, can you confirm Jordan will provide the ID?

Attached: acme_invoice_sample.csv

Elena Ruiz
Acme Supplies — Accounts Receivable

Jordan/Vivek — forwarding the exchange with Acme. Quick asks:

1) Jordan: can you confirm the Redwood merchant ID mapping for Payflow and attach the ID so Elena can finish activation? If we need a PR/contract signature to enable production uploads, please flag.
2) Vivek: please confirm we are comfortable with the 30-day email fallback policy for initial onboarding and whether we should tighten to 14 days for vendors without consistent PO stamping.

I recommend we update the vendor onboarding form (attached) with:
- required file naming convention
- mandatory CSV header fields (invoice_id,po_number,gross_amount,invoice_date)
- fallback subject line spec: we will accept both "PO:12345" and "PO#12345" but prefer the colon format.

If both of you approve I will: (a) add the CSV template to the onboarding doc, (b) notify Acme to perform one test upload, and (c) mark the vendor as "portal-enabled" in the vendor master.

Thanks — Monica

Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
